_comment: ElevenLabs takes: one recording per voice, one line per paragraph. tools/split-voices.py cuts them at the pauses and writes assets/audio/manifest.json (voices: text -> file, coach: key -> file).
villager_m: Thy legs are made of iron!
Hark! A rider from the south!
May the saints guard thy wheels!
The castle is under siege, beware!
villager_f: Is that a horse without legs?
Bread! Warm bread for the weary!
Push, push, the hill is nigh!
The feast is in the town square!
knights: Row, ye dogs! Beat the rider!
Race thee to the castle, cyclist!
